stem.text: Acid rain continues to be a problem.
Which statements about acid rain are correct?

items: Acid rain is formed when oxides of nitrogen or oxides of sulfur react with water in the atmosphere.
Acid rain causes an increase in the concentration of heavy metal ions in water courses.
Nitrogen dioxide will catalyse the formation of $\text{SO}_3$ from $\text{SO}_2$ in the atmosphere.
